note: This template does not expose its inputs through a subgraph, so it has no slot_overrides addresses — `slots` is empty for that reason, not because the template is uneditable. Override it with run_template's `input_overrides` instead, keyed by the node ids in `nodes` below: {"<id>": {"<input_name>": value}}. `nodes` is the executed graph run_template submits, so these ids and input names are exactly the ones input_overrides resolves against. Inputs wired from another node are omitted — setting one would replace the link with a constant; use get_template + submit_workflow for that kind of structural edit. Some values below are not shown verbatim: an entry with `values_truncated` lists the input names whose string value is a clipped prefix, and `inputs_truncated` means inputs were left out entirely (too many, or a value too large to render). Do not echo a clipped value back as an override — read the full value from get_template.
